messages:
Olivia Harper: Quick async — Cayenne enterprise trial starts next Wed (2025-06-11). Need a gap assessment: owners for integration deliverables, must-have success criteria, any infra/security blockers. Trying to avoid a last-minute fire drill. TL;DR: who owns what and when?

Sasha Kim: I can own the integration checklist for the runtime side. Immediate items I see:
- sample payload schema from Cayenne
- network egress rules (CIDR)
- API key exchange + rotation plan
- test data with PII flagged/stripped

Can we get sample schema by EOD Monday? @OliviaHarper

Matt Cho: On infra side I'll own staging endpoint rollout and test harness. ETA: can have a staging endpoint + smoke tests by Tue EOD if we get the sample schema and a staging dataset.

Olivia Harper: Great — Sasha + Matt. I'll ping the customer for the schema and confirm they can provide a sanitized dataset.

Ana Rivera: Success criteria from product:
- 95th p50 token latency < 200ms on 2k QPS synthetic load
- No functional regressions vs baseline prompts (we have 20 eval prompts)
- End-to-end feature toggles working (canary on/off)
- Data residency confirmation (logs stay in EU)

I'll drop the acceptance tests into the shared doc.

Kevin O'Neill: Heads up — Dedicated pool capacity needs a reservation for the trial window. If they run sustained load we'll need to pre-warm 2x the expected replicas. Also need to add a short maintenance blackout on Wed night for the new routing policy. I'll coordinate with eng-sre.

Priya Desai: From solutions eng: will validate integrations and own canary plan. Proposed canary: 5% traffic for 2 hours -> 25% for 4 hours -> full. Rollback on error rate > 1% or latency spike > 2x baseline. Need a runbook snippet for rollback.

Ramon Gupta: Security notes:
- Ensure API keys transit via our KMS and customer keys are not stored in plaintext.
- Audit logging must be enabled; retention policy for trial logs = 30 days.
- Confirm encryption in transit + at rest for any sample datasets.
If they require SOC2 scoping, we need 48h notice.

Sasha Kim: Quick sample config for keys (for dev/staging):
```
# staging env var example
REDWOOD_API_KEY=redacted
CAYENNE_CLIENT_ID=cayenne-xyz
CAYENNE_ALLOWED_CIDR=203.0.113.0/24
```
Will also add a small test script to repo: `scripts/cayenne-smoke.sh` that hits /health and /generate with one prompt.

Matt Cho: Adding the smoke test to CI. Example curl for smoke: 
```
curl -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -d '{"model":"redwood-small","prompt":"hello"}'
```
If smoke fails, CI warns and doesn't deploy.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy to staging window 2025-06-09 02:00 UTC (will attempt 1 rollback on failure). :gear:

Olivia Harper: Outstanding blockers list (from thread):
- customer to provide sanitized sample dataset + schema (owner: Olivia) — need by Mon EOD
- security signoff on key exchange + logging (owner: Ramon) — need by Tue 12:00 UTC
- infra reservation request (owner: Kevin) — need by Tue 18:00 UTC
- canary runbook draft (owner: Priya) — need by Wed 09:00 UTC

Please reply with quick ack or if you want to swap ownership. If everything looks good I'll convert to an action list and assign tasks in Asana. :thumbsup:

Priya Desai: Ack. I'll draft the canary runbook and post link here when ready.

Kevin O'Neill: Ack. I'll submit reservation request and ping eng-sre channel.

Ramon Gupta: I'll review key exchange + logging today, expect signoff before Tue noon.

Sasha Kim: I'll prep the smoke script and add sample config to the repo. Target PR by Mon afternoon.

Matt Cho: PR for CI tweaks by Mon evening.

Olivia Harper: Perfect — will follow up with customer infra team now. Thanks all. :pray:
